L1Menu_CollisionsHeavyIons2026_v1_0_2

This document was generated from an intermediate development snapshot.
  • Comment: v1_0_2:
    Fix on some monitoring trigger seed names


    Menu for PbPb collisions 2026, based on v 1_0_3 of the same for 2025.

    + additional ZDC/HF triggers for rate asymmetry monitoring
    + DoubleEG3 triggers with phi requirement
    + triggers used in OO in 2025 in case there is OO data-taking
    + Centrality-gated trigger with HF1AND, for cleaner signals for beamspot.

    ====================================================

    Menu for PbPb collisions 2025.


    v 1_0_3 - The changes relative to the 2025 PbPb menu (v1_0_2) are:

    + Change of name of same-side trigger seed XOR -->AsymXOR (logic remains the same)
    + Addition of backup threshold seeds for MinimumBiasZDC2n and 3n
    + Reordering of seeds

    v 1_0_2 - The changes relative to the 2025 PbPb menu (v1_0_1) are:

    + Seeds 100-107 - Changed MinimumBiasZDC to UPCZDC in seed names (logic is the same)
    + Backup seeds for HFXOR and ZDCXOR topologies, monitoring seeds for HFplus and HFminus noise.

    v 1_0_1 - The changes relative to the 2025 PbPb menu (v1_0_0) are:

    + L1_SingleEG3_BptxAND, 4, 5
    + L1_SingleEG3, 4, 5
    + L1_DoubleEG2_BptxAND
    + L1_SingleJet8, 12, 16, 24, 28
    + L1_SingleJet8_BptxAND, 12,16,24
    + L1_SingleMuOpen_Centrality_40_100_BptxAND

    The changes relative to the 2024 PbPb menu (v1_0_6) are:

    - removal of unused triggers (e.g. uncorrected jets, rapidity-gap triggers, SingleEG SingleMu cross-triggers)
    - addition of ZDC monitoring seeds inspired from the 2025 OO menu
    - addition of triggers with non-zero prescales from menus used in cosmics and circulating runs
    - addition of double jet delta phi + ZDC triggers (e.g. L1_DoubleJet*_DeltaPhi2p0_UPCZDC1n_Th#_XOR_BptxAND), with *=8,12,16 and #=1,2,3
    - addition of a new set of seeds for soft photonuclear interactions - L1_UPCZDC1n_Th#_XOR_MinimumBiasHF&_OR_SameSide_BptxAND, with #=1,2,3 and &=1,2 thresholds
    - addition of backup eta- and Bptx-gated EG triggers.
